name: OPOVD: Delo o propavshem polovnike
source:
After the first "particularly important case," it seemed the camp should have drawn some conclusions.
But this is Sovyonok.
Here, conclusions are only drawn when it's already too late.
A new morning begins with a new incident: A ladle has gone missing from the dining hall.
An ordinary kitchen item? Perhaps.
But not when there is less and less time left until lunch, and the management has already declared a state of emergency.
Semyon once again finds himself at the head of the DFPIC - a department to which nobody really invited him, but from which he now somehow cannot resign.
Together with Elektronik and Ulyana, he has to figure out where the item, without which the normal existence of the camp has suddenly become impossible, could have disappeared.
And then everything goes on as usual: Suspicions, strange testimonies, dubious theories, very serious faces, and an investigation that becomes less and less like an investigation with every passing minute.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3713993950]Steam[/url]]
